description: A reference to a single source column, by stable ColumnModel id, on a specific source object version. After build-time flattening these always name a leaf source (a base table or view) column.

sourceObjectId.description: The id of the source object the column belongs to (e.g. 'syn123').

sourceVersionNumber.description: The pinned version of the source object, or null when the source is not version-pinned.

sourceColumnId.description: The stable ColumnModel id of the source column.
